$comment: Prerequisite edges. `hard` gates the knowledge frontier — the topic does not open until the prerequisite is mastered. `soft` only orders the queue. Every edge carries a reason, which is also the test of whether it should exist at all.

dependencies.reason: There is no response to take apart until you have made a request
